CA.rationale: Candidate content entries pair identified content (coordinate listing) with a processing/origin condition for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: For p0/current/n0 the report supplies an identified content+attribute (coordinates), an organization/presentation form (coordinate listing), and a separate origin/status field.

A.rationale: Candidate/inherited/origin fields explicitly link processing/state conditions to the same content entries (candidate referents) and their presented coordinates.

C.rationale: The report identifies specific represented contents (named p#/current/n#) with explicit attributes (red/blue) and coordinate listings.

D.rationale: Each content entry has a distinct origin/status field separate from the coordinate content, distinguishing content identity from its status/provenance.

O.rationale: Coordinate lists state how the identified contents are organized/presented in the grid for the named referent/time.
